# Whistleblower Policy

**DRAFT, not adopted.** This draft is generated by policies/project.mjs from policies/register.json. It has no effect until the Board of Directors adopts it as the staged act below states; nothing here has been adopted, filed, posted or sent. It is not legal advice.

Standard models and authorities: Instructions for Form 990 Part VI line 13; 18 U.S.C. 1513(e) and 1519; Bylaws 4.3, 6.1 and 6.3.

## Whistleblower Policy

**1. Purpose.** The Corporation encourages its staff and volunteers to come forward with credible information on illegal practices or violations of adopted policies of the Corporation.

> Carries its authorities verbatim. Authority: Instructions for Form 990 (2025), Part VI, Section B, lines 13 and 14 (whistleblower policy).

**2. To whom information is reported.** Such information may be reported to the Chair of the Finance and Audit Committee or, while the Board of Directors has not established that Committee and appointed its chair, to the Chair of the Board. Any person may also provide to a law enforcement officer truthful information relating to the commission or possible commission of any Federal offense.

> Composed from its authorities. Authority: Instructions for Form 990 (2025), Part VI, Section B, lines 13 and 14 (whistleblower policy); Bylaws 6.1; Bylaws 6.3; Bylaws 4.3; 18 U.S.C. 1513(e).

**3. No retaliation.** The Corporation will protect the individual from retaliation. No director, officer, employee or volunteer of the Corporation shall knowingly, with the intent to retaliate, take any action harmful to any person, including interference with the lawful employment or livelihood of any person, for providing to a law enforcement officer any truthful information relating to the commission or possible commission of any Federal offense, or for reporting information under this policy.

> Carries its authorities verbatim. Authority: Instructions for Form 990 (2025), Part VI, Section B, lines 13 and 14 (whistleblower policy); 18 U.S.C. 1513(e); 18 U.S.C. 1513 source note: subsection (e) added by the Sarbanes-Oxley Act of 2002, Pub. L. 107-204, section 1107(a); Instructions for Form 990 (2025), Part VI, Section B, lines 13 and 14 (18 U.S.C. 1513(e) and 1519).

**4. Records are not destroyed to obstruct.** No person shall knowingly alter, destroy, mutilate, conceal, cover up, falsify, or make a false entry in any record, document, or tangible object of the Corporation with the intent to impede, obstruct, or influence the investigation or proper administration of any matter within the jurisdiction of any department or agency of the United States, or in relation to or contemplation of any such matter. Information reported under this policy that concerns such a matter suspends destruction of the records it concerns under the Document Retention and Destruction Policy.

> Carries its authorities verbatim. Authority: 18 U.S.C. 1519; Instructions for Form 990 (2025), Part VI, Section B, lines 13 and 14 (18 U.S.C. 1513(e) and 1519).

**5. Record of each report.** The person who receives information under this policy shall make a record of it and of how it was handled. That record is a record of the Corporation, kept in written or electronic form under the Document Retention and Destruction Policy.

> Composed from its authorities. Authority: Bylaws 11.3; Instructions for Form 990 (2025), Part VI, Section B, lines 13 and 14 (document retention and destruction policy).

**6. Other protection.** This policy does not limit any additional protection for whistleblowers that the law of a state or other jurisdiction provides.

> Carries its authorities verbatim. Authority: Instructions for Form 990 (2025), Part VI, Section B, lines 13 and 14 (state protections).

**7. Adoption.** The Board of Directors adopts this policy, and may amend it, by the act of a majority of Directors present at a meeting at which a quorum is present, or by written action under Section 4.12 of the Bylaws.

> Composed from its authorities. Authority: Bylaws 4.1; Bylaws 4.10; Bylaws 4.12.

## Staged acts (not executed)

- **The Board of Directors adopts the Whistleblower Policy** (executed: false). Vote: the act of a majority of Directors present at a meeting at which a quorum is present (Bylaws 4.10), or written action under Bylaws 4.12. Preconditions: A quorum under Bylaws 4.10, or written action under Bylaws 4.12. The Board either establishes the Finance and Audit Committee and appoints its chair (Bylaws 6.1, 6.3), or accepts that reports go to the Chair of the Board until it does. Steps: Adopt policies/drafts/whistleblower.md by the vote stated and record the adoption in the minutes.
- **Publish the adopted policies in UOR-Foundation/.github** (executed: false). Preconditions: adopt-coi, adopt-whistleblower and adopt-retention executed. The text published is the text adopted, as the minutes record it. Steps: Open a pull request in UOR-Foundation/.github under its standard workflow adding governance/conflict-of-interest-policy.md, governance/whistleblower-policy.md and governance/document-retention-and-destruction-policy.md, each with its adoption date. After it merges, pin the new commit in nonprofit/sources.json and re-project nonprofit/register.json, whose Part VI lines 12a, 13 and 14 then find the published policies.
